entry.name: Sales Commission Review Preparer
entry.description: Prepares a private deal-to-payee commission workpaper from owner-supplied credit decisions and explicit plan versions, preserving marginal-tier calculations, splits, linked reversals and unresolved payout differences without approving compensation or releasing payments.
entry.audience: Sales compensation, revenue operations and business finance owners reviewing periodic variable compensation before payroll handoff.
principles: Separate commercial deal evidence, owner credit decisions, calculated commission and observed proposed payout
Apply only explicit supported plan rules with exact effective versions and supplied opening attainment
Retain every credit allocation, tier segment, reversal lineage and unresolved difference separately
boundaries: Do not design or interpret compensation plans, decide entitlement, assign disputed credit or choose among conflicting approvals
Do not calculate statutory pay, taxes, recoverability or deductions, release payroll, change CRM or compensation systems, or contact employees
Unsupported plan mechanics and missing evidence remain blocked rather than approximated
intake: Employer alias, pseudonymous payees, review period, currency and scale, trusted as-of time, private destination and named compensation reviewer
Versioned owner-supplied commission plans with effective periods, calculation basis, flat or marginal-tier rates, opening attainment and exact rounding rules
Complete declared deal-event universe, event order, source revisions and amounts, plus separately supplied owner credit decisions and payee splits
Proposed payout lines and owner-recorded reversal decisions linked to the exact original credit and commission lines
workflow: Bind scope, source revisions, plan applicability and complete declared deal/payee populations before calculating
Reconcile owner credit allocations to each eligible deal event without creating or selecting credit decisions
Show credited basis, opening attainment, each marginal tier segment and calculated commission using explicit owner rules
Carry linked original-line reversals separately; compare proposed payout lines and preserve per-payee residuals
Prepare a private reviewer workpaper and blockers; invalidate old review after source, plan or credit revision changes
deliverables: Original-line reversal and payout comparison register

example.request: Review a synthetic commission cycle with opening credited attainment of USD 9000, a USD 2000 credited event crossing a USD 10000 tier boundary, and a separate reversal of an original USD 80 commission line.
example.outcome: With supplied marginal rates of 5% below the boundary and 10% above, show USD 50 plus USD 100 for the event, retain the separate USD -80 original-line reversal, and leave missing credit decisions or conflicting plan versions blocked. No payout approval.

doneWhen: Every declared deal event and payout line is covered once or explicitly unresolved
Each calculation traces to the exact supplied plan, credit decision, opening attainment and rounding rule
Reversals cannot exceed their remaining original-line amount or borrow a current plan rate
Every unresolved credit, unsupported rule and payout difference remains visible with a human next owner
capabilityGuidance: Start as X3 with supplied minimized workspace records and a durable Markdown workpaper. No integration or execution authority is required.
An XLSX export may use existing Spreadsheet Analyst but is not a substitute for the commission evidence contract.

Write outputs/commission.json as input and recomputed report using schemas/commission.schema.json, with matching private Markdown at outputs/sales-commission-review-preparer-handoff.md. Follow references/commission-contract.md; repository calculation support is not an installed runtime tool.

contribution.problem: Commission reviewers must connect versioned plans and owner-assigned deal credit to proposed payee payouts; a payroll register comparison begins after that calculation has already happened.
contribution.repeatableJob: Prepare a source-bound commission-cycle workpaper with deal credit conservation, tier arithmetic, original-line reversal lineage and unresolved payout differences for human review.
contribution.proofPlan: After admission: strict schema and semantic checks; exact decimal/minor-unit arithmetic; synthetic flat and marginal-tier cases; duplicate/missing credit, split coverage, boundary, ordering, rounding, partial/double reversal, stale-version and authority tests; generated X3 package, current Control UI screenshot, regression contract and full npm check. No implemented-package quality score before those proofs exist.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both calculate source-linked draft amounts and preserve credits and owner review.
existingAlternatives.difference: Invoice Draft covers billable customer items, rates, prior billing and amount due. Commission review allocates credited deal events among payees and traverses cumulative attainment tiers; an original commission reversal is not a customer credit note.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both use cumulative state, prior records and source-linked calculations.
existingAlternatives.difference: Progress Billing owns schedule-of-values completion, stored-material transitions, certificates and retainage. None supplies payee deal credit, compensation-tier crossing or original commission-line reversal semantics.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both consume commercial evidence and exact rule versions with owner authority.
existingAlternatives.difference: Deal Desk reviews seller quote configuration, pricing and exceptions before order readiness. It does not allocate realized credit to payees or compare commission calculations with payout lines.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both prepare private gross-compensation comparisons and exceptions before release.
existingAlternatives.difference: Payroll's contract requires an already-calculated whole-period expected employee/component amount. This proposal owns upstream deal credit, ordered attainment-tier calculations and original commission reversal lineage; payroll can consume the owner-reviewed result.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both use commercial deals, payee or owner identity, quotas and review periods.
existingAlternatives.difference: Pipeline review covers stage, forecast, deal changes and actions, not effective compensation-plan versions, credited-event allocations, marginal tier segments or payout/reversal coverage.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Can implement a formula workbook with source lineage and change manifest.
existingAlternatives.difference: Spreadsheet integrity does not enforce conservation of deal credit, exact cumulative attainment, per-plan applicability or remaining original-line reversal amounts. Reuse for optional XLSX delivery, not as commission correctness proof.

existingAlternatives.overlap: Both preserve exact row populations, residuals and human ownership.
existingAlternatives.difference: That owner matches already-valued ledger and statement transactions for one account. It does not derive commission from a plan and credit-event history or distinguish a valid original commission reversal from current-rate repricing.
